summary: Recursive merge sort of a singly-linked list whose next pointer lives at node+4, using a deterministic comparator driven by a 104-entry priority table rooted at dword_7CD2AC+58384. Walks the list to count nodes, splits it at the midpoint, sorts each half recursively via self-call, then merges the halves by comparing each head's packed key: the top two bits (value>>29), a masked sub-field (value>>18 & 0x3F), the low byte with a 255 sentinel, and position in the priority table. Consumed by EntityVisibilityGridManager (00465460) for entity ordering.

operations.description: If the list head a1 is null, return it unchanged (empty list)
Count the nodes by following the next pointer at node+4 until a null link is reached
If fewer than 2 nodes, return the list unchanged as already sorted
Compute the midpoint (count/2 - 1) and advance to that node via the +4 links
Capture the right-half head at the midpoint's next pointer, then split the list by writing 0 to the midpoint's next pointer
Recursively sort the left half (original head)
Recursively sort the right half (captured head)

Merge loop: while both halves remain, compare the two head keys with the priority-table comparator; each head's packed key is inspected via the top two bits (value>>29), a masked sub-field (value>>18 & 0x3F), the low byte versus the 255 sentinel, and equality tests against the 104-entry priority table at dword_7CD2AC+58384

Winner relink: advance the winning half's head to its next pointer and append the winning node to the tail of the merged list, walking the priority-table pointer forward when the comparator needs a later entry (bounded by 104 entries)
When one half is exhausted, append the remaining half's nodes to the merged list tail, or a null terminator when both halves are spent
Return the head of the merged list; the sort is used by EntityVisibilityGridManager (00465460)
